newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL 359-9 AT CLOSE AGAINST NORTHERN TVL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL 359-9 AT CLOSE AGAINST NORTHERN TVL.

text.p: Northern Transvaal were made to regret putting Natal into bat on the opening day of the four-day Castle Cup match at Centurion Park as the visitors reached 359 for nine at the close of a day which began late at 11:30 due to overnight rain.
Half centuries from Errol Stewart and Neil Johnson were the features of the innings, but there were sound contributions all the way down the order.
Out of favour national opening batsman Rudi Steyn added 66 for the second wicket with Stewart before falling for 45, one of three victims for paceman Rudi Bryson.

Stewart was eventually out for 78, made from 166 balls with 10 boundaries, after adding 90 for the fifth wicket with Johnson. Johnson was caught behind off Mike Rindel's left arm seam for a fluent 69. He hit nine fours and two sixes in a stay of 101 balls.

There was further frustration for Northerns down the order where Shaun Pollock (32) and Keith Forde (30) held up proceedings. Then an unbroken last wicket stand of 54 between Anthony Botha (24) and Tertius Bosch (31) rubbed further salt into Northern's wounds.
